lastHandoff.summary: Continued DESIGN.md implementation in PurchasesForMePage and PurchasesMadePage. Improved the PurchasesForMe repay CTA touch target, removed excessive card shadow, adjusted empty-state spacing for mobile, and improved breakdown label readability. PurchasesMadePage is now aligned with restrained card styling and uses a larger accessible delete-action target; its itemized breakdown label uses clearer typography. Existing purchase APIs, privacy-scoped queries, delete behavior, repayment navigation, and paise calculations remain intact. npm run typecheck and npm run build pass.
lastHandoff.decisions: Keep purchase history cards low-elevation, use semantic design tokens, prioritize 44px touch targets, and preserve separate '/purchases/made' and '/purchases/for-me' queries to maintain privacy scopes. Vite bundle warning remains (~831 KB minified).
lastHandoff.nextSteps: Continue CommonExpensesPage and ProfilePage. Inspect actual current files before each exact edit. Then review Shell routing and page title duplication, and consider route-level code splitting to address the large bundle warning. Finish with typecheck/build and critical-flow review.
